title: New image model, newer DeepSeek
summary:
GPT Image 1.5 and DeepSeek V3.2 joined the model lineup, while pricing and in-flight spending became easier to account for.

Added `gptimage-large` for text-to-image generation and image editing, backed by GPT Image 1.5. The `deepseek` model now routes to V3.2, with a `deepseek-v3.2` alias. Veo 3.1 Fast’s registry metadata also now identifies its existing image-to-video support, including start and end frames.

Generation requests now reserve an estimated charge before processing, so balance checks account for requests already in flight; the final charge replaces the estimate when processing finishes. Model information now uses registry field names for Pollen prices, and text requests stop rather than continuing with a partially converted image URL.

The new site layout gained a dismissible banner linking to the old site. The app directory added Shaper AI by @stanica, a Chrome extension for page editing, writing, chat, and PDF summaries. The README’s Latest News section was refreshed with December 22 updates; that edit did not change the underlying services.

highlights.title: GPT Image 1.5 added
highlights.text: Use `gptimage-large` to generate images from text or edit images with text and image inputs. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gptimage-large).

highlights.title: DeepSeek moves to V3.2
highlights.text: The `deepseek` model now uses DeepSeek V3.2; `deepseek-v3.2` is available as an alias. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=deepseek-v3.2).
